subject: Vendor registration + PO acceptance details for Nova Retail
messages:
From: Alison Park <alison.park@novaretail.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novaretail.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration + PO acceptance details for Nova Retail

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking our call this morning. To keep procurement and AP moving, can you confirm the following so we can create Redwood as an approved vendor in our system and route POs correctly?

Quick list:
- Legal entity name and tax ID to appear on the vendor record
- Remit-to bank details (ACH or wire) and preferred payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45)
- Invoicing header fields we must populate to tie invoices to POs (e.g., Redwood customer ID or reference)
- Does Redwood accept a consolidated monthly invoice per account or do you require invoice-per-PO?
- Any VAT registration / reverse-charge notes for EU invoices (we have EU subsidiaries that occasionally purchase)

We also need a short AP contact name/email and a W-9 or equivalent vendor tax document for our file. If you can attach a sample invoice with the fields populated that helps our mapping team.

Thanks — aim to have the vendor record created this week if possible.

Best,
Alison
Procurement Manager
Nova Retail

From: diego_fernandez@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO acceptance details for Nova Retail

Alison —

Appreciate the clear checklist. See answers below and attached documents (W-9 + bank stub + sample invoice). I'll loop in Marissa and Karthik for PO routing and invoicing behavior.

1) Legal entity / tax ID:
   - Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - EIN: 81-2345678

2) Remit / bank details (we prefer ACH):
   - Bank: Redwood Community Bank (stub attached)
   - Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Routing / Account numbers: see attached bank_stub.pdf (we provide both ACH and wire fields)
   - Preferred payment terms: Net 30 by default; we are open to Net 45 for strategic pilots (please note in vendor record).

3) Invoicing header / PO mapping:
   - Please ensure the PO's "Bill To" references Nova Retail account code and include the PO number in the invoice "Reference" field.
   - Our required invoice fields to match a PO automatically: PO Number, Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Redwood Customer Account ID (RED-67890) — include RED-67890 in the invoice header or invoice line metadata.
   - We can accept consolidated monthly invoices for multiple POs under the same account; however, to auto-apply to POs your AP system must include the individual PO numbers in the invoice body. If PO numbers are absent, matching will fail and payment will be delayed.

4) VAT / EU notes:
   - Redwood is not VAT-registered in the EU for standard marketplace sales. For purchases routed to an EU legal entity you should expect invoices showing Gross amounts; where reverse charge applies we can provide a VAT self-assessment note on the invoice if you supply the EU VAT number and designate the recipient as the taxable party. For Nova's accounting team we can coordinate a separate template if needed.

5) AP contact and documents:
   - AP contact: ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com (monitored by our billing team)
   - Attached: redwood_w9_and_bank_stub.pdf, sample-invoice-REDWOOD-20240318.pdf

Next steps: Marissa will confirm whether we can generate invoice-per-PO by default or provide a consolidated monthly billing option with PO references. If you want us in your vendor portal "whitelist" please share the vendor portal link and any required credentials and we'll complete the form.

Diego Fernandez
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

(Attachment stubs: redwood_w9_and_bank_stub.pdf [pdf], sample-invoice-REDWOOD-20240318.pdf [pdf])

Diego / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick reply. A couple follow-ups from our mapping team:

- The file import requires a VAT field to be present even when blank; can you confirm the exact string you'd like us to populate in the "VAT Number" column when you do not have an EU VAT? (e.g., "N/A", "NONE", or leave blank)
- For consolidated invoices: will the sample PDF you sent show line-level PO numbers? Our system can ingest line-level PO references but only if they are in the same column name as "PO Number".
- Our security team also needs to confirm whether Redwood handles customer PII on invoices (we redact end-customer info; does your team accept redacted line items?)

If you can reply this afternoon, we can close the vendor ticket and route a test PO (PO 789234).

— Samir
Nova Retail — AP Systems

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2024 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO acceptance details for Nova Retail

Hi Samir —

Quick answers from our billing team (copying Karthik for AP mapping):

- VAT field: please populate with the literal string "NO_VAT" when Redwood has no EU VAT registration. That avoids an empty cell during import and our downstream systems strip that value on EU-facing invoices.

- Consolidated invoice behavior: our sample invoice contains line-level PO references in the column labelled "PO Number". We confirm that any consolidated invoice we send will include a "PO Number" column for each line so your ingestion pipeline can match to individual PO rows. If you prefer the PO number also in the invoice header, we can also add "POs: 789234, 789235" in the invoice description field—let us know which you prefer.

- PII on invoices: we do not require end-customer PII on line items for billing purposes; we can accept redacted line items. If Nova needs non-redacted data for reconciliation, we can provide a secure file transfer option (SFTP) for detailed remittance files instead of embedding PII in the invoice PDF.

Next steps:
1) We'll complete your vendor portal form if you provide the portal link and temporary upload token.
2) Please send the test PO (789234) to invoices@redwoodinference.com; we'll submit a test invoice back with header + line-level PO numbers within 24 hours.

Marissa Cole
Billing Manager
Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0192
